Google FLEURS (Few-shot Learning Evaluation of Universal Representations of Speech)
Alexis Conneau et al., 2022

Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/fleurs
Pinned revision: 70bb2e84b976b7e960aa89f1c648e09c59f894dd
Dataset card: https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/fleurs/blob/70bb2e84b976b7e960aa89f1c648e09c59f894dd/README.md
Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2205.12446

The upstream dataset declares Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International:
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
Legal terms: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode

The audio and human transcripts in testdata/natural retain these terms.
Selection: first three WAV members in each pinned test archive for en_us,
fr_fr, de_de, es_419, ru_ru and el_gr. No selection by recognition quality.
Changes: audio converted with FFmpeg to mono 16 kHz PCM16, then little-endian
float32 samples (PCM16 / 32768) and gzip-compressed for test storage. Human
transcripts are retained in manifest.json. Separate fp32.json/int8.json files
record model predictions and are not corrected human transcriptions.

The manifest records each archive URL/member, original and converted hashes,
dataset identifiers, conversion version, and source transcript. Preserve this
attribution, the license reference, and the modification description when
redistributing these fixtures. No endorsement by the dataset authors is implied.
